settings.description: The built-in styles every person can choose, as a JSON list of objects, each with an id (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and never sixteen hexadecimal characters), a name and the instructions on tone and format a chat that uses it is given. A style with no instructions sends nothing. A person cannot change or delete a built-in style; they make their own.

The id of the style a new chat uses until the person chooses another: a built-in style's id or one of their own. A chat's first turn keeps it as the chat's own, so a later change reaches new chats only. An id that names no style sends none.

settings.default: The person chose the style "{name}" for this chat. Follow it for the tone and format of your replies, and for nothing else:
settings.description: The line before a style's instructions, at the start of every call of a chat that uses it. {name} becomes the style's name. Empty sends the instructions alone.
The most styles of their own a person may have, from 0 to 1000. The built-in styles are not counted.
The most characters a style's name may have, from 1 to 200.
The most characters a style's instructions may have, from 1 to 50000. They go into every call of every chat that uses the style, at the start, so a provider can cache them.
